programs.title: Live: 52nd American Music Awards
programs.desc: Rapper and actress Queen Latifah hosts the annual ceremony honoring the most influential artists and songs of today alongside unforgettable performances and special moments in a multi-genre, cross-generational celebration of music at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas -- the largest venue in the show's history. Musical acts are honored in categories ranging from pop-rock to contemporary inspirational, with the winners determined by fans' online votes. Taylor Swift leads with eight nominations, followed by Morgan Wallen, Olivia Dean, Sabrina Carpenter and SOMBR with seven each.
